notes: SAS certification-exam scenario: read Cert.Temp18, format Day as DATE9., derive Month from Day, run a one-way PROC FREQ on HighTemp, and PROC MEANS (mean/stddev) for AvgHighTemp/AvgLowTemp by Month, plus two follow-up questions (HighTemp=53 frequency, AvgLowTemp mean/stddev for Month=2). The original LIBNAME points at a local Windows path holding the SAS-cert-guide TEMP18 practice dataset (daily weather readings), which isn't in the repo (its extract, SAS Project/D.TXT, was removed from the repo before this bundle was built); substituted a same-shape 14-row mock Work.Scenario7 via DATALINES spanning January and February so the author's own format/derive/PROC FREQ/PROC MEANS sequence runs unmodified. One mechanical rewrite was needed to make the DATALINES-based mock work: the original reused the variable name Day across the raw character input and the DATE9.-formatted numeric conversion (a name/type collision against the fixed PDV type from SET); renamed the raw character field to DayChar and derived Day via input(DayChar, date9.), dropping DayChar, to preserve the author's format/derive logic.
